hooks.name: Run tests on Lambda handler save
hooks.description: Runs the pytest suite whenever a Lambda handler.py is saved, so regressions surface immediately.

action.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .)" && AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-east-2 .venv/bin/python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -15
